companyDescription: AI GPU king · Dominant H100/Blackwell AI training chips + CUDA ecosystem + data center Ethernet switch leader — picks & shovels of the AI era
priceNote: Dipped below $200 support — ATH $236.54 back in Feb. Avg analyst PT $309 implies 60% upside. Q2 FY27 earnings Aug 26 is the next re-rate catalyst.
summary: NVIDIA remains the undisputed AI infrastructure king at $4.72T market cap. The stock has pulled back ~18% from its $236 ATH, creating a compelling re-entry. 38 analysts hold a Strong Buy consensus with an average 12-month PT of $309.33 — implying 60.5% upside. Q2 FY2027 earnings (Aug 26) + Rubin GPU platform ramp in H2 2026 are the twin re-rate catalysts. July 27-31 (FOMC + Big Tech earnings) is the key risk window to watch.

catalysts.name: Q2 FY2027 Earnings
catalysts.description: NVIDIA reports Aug 26, 2026. Revenue consensus $91.7B, EPS $2.08. Another beat + Rubin guidance would push toward $230-250. Blackwell ramp remains demand-constrained.

catalysts.name: Rubin GPU Platform Launch
catalysts.description: Next-gen Rubin GPU (successor to Blackwell) confirmed for H2 2026. Hyperscalers already pre-ordering — another platform upgrade cycle that cements NVDA's GPU monopoly for 2026-2027.
